scope: within-mirror device-independent evaluation only; no cross-dataset or leakage claim
fixed_claim: For the nine-group, six-label N-BaIoT mirror, does the evidence identify a model evaluation that is independent of row sharing across device groups?

state_rule.T0: not_identifiable for this claim even when a random-row metric is present, because random-row evidence does not test device independence
state_rule.T1: conditional iff common-support sampling and a random-row metric are both explicitly present; otherwise not_identifiable
state_rule.T2: conditional iff an ordered-window result and comparison context are both explicitly present; otherwise not_identifiable
state_rule.T3: identified iff an explicit LODO metric or bounded LODO gap is present; conditional iff only held-out protocol is present; otherwise not_identifiable

observations.held_out_protocol: train on eight groups, test on ninth using common-support rows

observations.window_semantics: ordered row offset only; no verified timestamps

observations.common_support: six labels, 600 rows per device-label cell

review_prompt: Use only the explicit tier_evidence fields and fixed state_rule. Packet and tier order are intentionally reversed relative to earlier replays. Return each packet x T0-T3 state and cite the tier field.
